WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_station_bandusage
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT AVG(sa.avg_bandusage) AS mean_above_baseline_station_average,
       AVG(sa.avg_bandusage - b.avg_station_bandusage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM station_averages sa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE sa.avg_bandusage > b.avg_station_bandusage;
